name: K-Town Connection
tagline: Your one stop shop for all things Kannapolis
about: Chris Hughes & Ryan Dayvault take you on a journey through their hometown, Kannapolis, N.C.: the latest happenings from Downtown Kannapolis and the whole community, with a little rough talk and old-school humor. Joined by broadcasting legend Chuck "Dr. Dave from Z-100" Irvin and David Steele in Big Dave's Sports Center.
